plan.notes: Transcribed from the official Hartnell College 'Emergency Medical Technician Academic Pathways' page (hartnell.edu, Health Sciences meta-major). The EMT Certificate of Achievement (CT.EMT) requires HES-80 Medical Terminology (3.0 units) and EMT-53 Emergency Medical Technician (9.0 units); the page states 'Recommended sequence. Courses can be scheduled before or concurrently with EMT-53.' Modeled as a single 12.0-unit term with both courses. To qualify for the National Registry Exam, students must pass with 80%, hold a current BLS card, and be 18 years of age; a background check, drug screen, physical, and vaccinations are required for the clinical phase.

courses.choice_note: Per the program page, HES-80 may be scheduled before or concurrently with EMT-53.
